title: A workspace of your own, wherever you are.
summary: Create a separate Mac workspace on your iPhone or iPad, keep the Mac available, manage shared files, and update the host from your phone. Update both apps together; this release uses protocol 25.

changes.title: Your own Mac workspace
changes.text: Add and end a virtual Mac display from the Displays picker. Choose a desktop size, Retina sharpness, a 30 or 60 fps limit, and optional rotation following in Workspace Settings. Virtual displays remain experimental and require Allow Virtual Displays on the Mac.

changes.title: Update the Mac from your phone
changes.text: Paired Macs can download and restart into a signed host update, even when streaming protocols differ. Older hosts need one manual installation of this update first.

changes.title: Manage your shared Mac files
changes.text: Create folders, rename and move files, and send items to Trash where the Mac has explicitly allowed file changes.

changes.title: A steadier Mac card menu
changes.text: The Mac card menu stays stable while playback and connection status refresh in the background.

changes.title: A separate desktop for remote work
changes.text: Enable a session-owned virtual display without changing your physical screen layout. Resize it in place, with generation checks that reject stale input during source changes.

changes.title: Stay available when you need it
changes.text: Keep the Mac awake during a remote session or for a chosen time, with battery-aware controls and a visible status in the menu.

changes.title: Signed updates with Sparkle
changes.text: Check for updates from the Mac menu or a paired phone. Update feeds and archives are signed, and PocketDesk closes remote sessions safely before restarting.

changes.title: Choose where file changes are allowed
changes.text: Grant write access separately for each shared folder. File changes stay within the folders you have enabled.
